result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: a confusing 0% discount badge, a truncated restaurant name, and a partially hidden card title in the popular list.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' pizza card shows a '-0%' discount badge, which is meaningless and looks like a broken or placeholder value.
issues.suggestion: Remove the badge when the discount is 0%, or replace it with a meaningful label such as 'No discount' or a valid percentage.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' section, the restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated and appears cut off at the right edge.
issues.suggestion: Allow text wrapping, reduce font size, or expand the card width so the full restaurant name is visible.

issues.description: The second card in 'Popular right now' is mostly visible, but its title and details are cut off at the bottom of the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Ensure cards are fully visible within the initial viewport or provide clear scrolling affordance so users know content continues below.
